lane: perf-exitgate-hang (wave-5 remediation: the interactive_daemon_e2e exit-gate hang family)
hypothesis: TRIAGE-PROVEN FAMILY (record 20260927-043000, bench 6c5ea95): the headless exit gate (pa-tui interactive.rs) waits for the full settle with NO timeout; a /switch racing the still-in-flight submit round trip strands a settle member and the run parks in run_interactive's block_on forever (30-45min CI job wedges, no failure name). ROOT-CAUSE ANALYSIS (this lane): the strand is the prompt/turn-end pairing watermark (session_ui.rs order_prompt_request): expected_turn_end = last_prompt_turn_end.max(turn_ends_seen)+1 counts ends the pane's subscription can never deliver — the outlived submit's turn_end is dropped by the switch (the detach retires the old subscription; the stale-session guard filters late copies), so the post-switch submit's expected end is inflated by one; when its own turn_end beats its ack to the client (worker acks at admission while the scripted instant turn streams in parallel; the events channel and the request channel are independent client-side tasks), the ack's re-arm gate (turn_ends_seen < expected) arms turn_active against a watermark no future end can reach — turn_active latches forever with the whole trio idle. FIX: (a) bound the headless settle (HEADLESS_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS=60s; a stuck member fails the run with the member named — HeadlessSettle.blockers()); (b) rebase the watermark at every attach (initial, /switch, supersede rebind): each submit reserves the next end the mounted subscription will deliver.
ts_parity: TS shutdown() has NO settle wait (stop -> dispose -> process.exit(0); in-flight submits dangle; inputSubmissionsPending drains in handleSubmit's own finally — the generation guards gate UI application, not the bookkeeping). The unbounded settle is a Rust headless-harness gap (the headless verifier has no TS counterpart), not a parity delta. The watermark itself is port-only (TS's single event loop cannot lose an end); its rebase enforces the pairing invariant the port needs (ends the pane can see), converging to TS semantics (the loader state follows the mounted session's event stream). Blast radius: UiMode::Headless is test-harness-only (34 uses, all pa-cli e2e + pa-tui unit); terminal runs never see HeadlessDone so the gate AND the bound are unreachable in real TUI (the exit_guard owns the live exit); user-visible effect in real TUI: none.
approach: Two files: crates/pa-tui/src/session_ui.rs (TurnEndWatermark extracted type: next_expected/note_turn_end/end_already_seen/rebase; attach_session rebases at the streaming resync; order_prompt_request/apply_prompt_outcome/TurnEnded use the type) and crates/pa-tui/src/interactive.rs (HeadlessSettle snapshot: the gate's 12 members, settled()==the old gate, blockers() names them; the gate breaks on settled(); HEADLESS_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS=60_000 bound armed at HeadlessDone, bail! with the members named on expiry). Unit tests: turn_end_watermark_tests (1:1 pairing on one subscription incl. the complete-turn-before-ack window; the switch latch replay — the post-switch submit's ack must not re-arm a turn that already ended; the rebase == fresh-pane uniform-shift oracle) + the_headless_settle_names_every_stuck_member (settled==old gate; every member named; the wedge member names 'a turn still active'). Behavior-preserving: same-session watermark decisions identical (uniform shift), green headless runs never reach the bound (settles are ms; the bound arms only after HeadlessDone; terminal runs never arm it), the suite's frame assertions (the frozen-surface oracle) stay green.
